name: apt.source.retarget
description: Point one apt sources file at the host's current release after an in-place upgrade: every suite in it that names an older release (focal, focal-pgdg) becomes the current one (jammy, jammy-pgdg). It never changes a URI, a key or anything else, and drops a line that would duplicate one already there. Before writing the file it refreshes the changed entries from a copy, and keeps the old file unless the source offers the current release signed by the key it already trusts. The old file is backed up under /var/backups/apt-sources.

file.description: A file in /etc/apt/sources.list.d, such as pgdg.list.

health_check: The helper refreshes the retargeted entries before keeping the change.
